_about: Published exploit chains, matched by CVE against each host's Nessus results. Add new chains from advisories here; min_match is how many of the listed CVEs must be present on one host.

chains.name: ProxyShell (Microsoft Exchange)
chains.reference: CISA alert AA21-321A; Microsoft Exchange security updates (2021)
chains.description: A pre-authentication path confusion, then privilege elevation in the Exchange PowerShell backend, then arbitrary file write, together give unauthenticated remote code execution.

chains.name: ProxyLogon (Microsoft Exchange)
chains.description: A server-side request forgery bypasses authentication, then post-authentication arbitrary file write leads to code execution.
